transitions.note: Resumed across ratified, PRE-DATA fixes: the bundle-argmax SAA move (interlens 8c5776b), the on-path SAA suppression benchmark (e300184), the announced-tie-break restoration (c6742ca), the universal replay-integrity gate (7fbeb9c), and the family-scoped equilibrium gate. POOLABILITY: the cells completed under the previous fingerprint (O2, X1, R3) are all single-item SEALED cells, and every one of those changes lives in a code path a sealed single-item episode never executes -- a sealed winner is decided by sealed_single_outcome against the stage tie-break, never by ledger standing. Verified directly: single-lot free-arm results are byte-identical across the changes on all 48 stages (revenue, efficiency, winners, prices, suppression, bid_benchmark_ratio). Two code vintages, ONE behavioral vintage; the earlier cells are poolable with the later ones.

Resumed to finish R1/R2 and to add X2. THREE things moved, and none of them touches what an already-bought episode contains. (1) auction_cells.py gains the X2 row -- a NEW cell only; no existing cell's config, arms, bank or seat assignment is altered, so R1-R5/O1-O3/X1 are byte-identical in definition and the completed cells stay poolable. X2 itself is PRE-DATA: design.md 6.1 preregisters it, its thresholds, and its frozen analysis code before any X2 episode exists. (2) The throughput lane's parallel free arms and corrected spend-guard sizing, which are protocol-neutral by construction: every worker rebuilds the identical plan and results reassemble in job order (tests/test_auction_throughput.py compares every field of every episode), and the sizing changes only WHEN money is committed, never a mechanism, prompt, bank, arm, seat or gate. (3) The operational cap is raised from $1600 to $2800 (hard cap $2885.28) because the original render fixed it below what the MEASURED per-episode costs require; the authorized ceiling of $3,833 is unchanged and unapproached. G2(b) has already FAILED on the frozen O1/X1 data and its withdrawal clause stands unretrofitted; X2 does not revisit it and cannot reinstate a persona claim for sealed second-price.
